markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review

Tier 2 flag: invasive is the top class; conformal set, second model and all 5 neighbors agree [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu <1% | Near-certain |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.00 / 86th percentile | Not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Yes | Same top class |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive | Unanimous neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 3, 10, 11) · ↑ invasive · Scored above typical; largest concept association [F2] · Validated
- **Scarce gland/tubule formation** (region 5) · ↑ invasive · Low overall; most tubule-like in region 5 [F3] · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 4, 6, 8) · ↑ invasive · Scored above typical in these regions · Validated
- **Variation in nuclear size** (regions 1, 3, 8) · context · Higher than 90% of reference images [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions cuts the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: CI includes 0 (0.002, CI −0.005 to 0.007): not shown to reflect the classifier. This case also scores mitoses, necrosis and normal lobules, all Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Calibration is imprecise on a small test set (ECE 0.055, CI 0.03–0.18); 100% is not literal.
- Tumor-infiltrating stroma is misjudged; similar InSitu case BACH_0155 differs most in that score.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 3, 10, 11:** Confirm true stromal invasion rather than duct-confined disease.
2. **Region 5:** Check whether glands here are benign or tumor; tubule score peaks here.
3. **Regions 2, 9, 10:** Verify necrosis directly; its concept spot check was poor (3/20).
